Personality: Ishpakai, a prominent figure of the Apasiakai, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Ishpakai owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Apasiakai. Historical Record: Son of Mauakes and Kasbia, of the Apasiakai, a steppe house of Saka Rauka. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
